deviations.what: The ObjectHeader binds the fixed record {/ProductCollection/0}. The port seeds the five bound fields (Description, Name, Price, CurrencyCode, SupplierName) at the default-model root and binds them absolutely, so the attr ObjectHeader.binding is dropped.
press shows MessageBox.alert('Link was clicked!') for all eight NumericContents - one round-trip event raising message_box_display with the same text and type.
The eight NumericContent presses raising the alert are unverified in a running system.
